answer.reason: Beyond the summary, the verses say that the city was allotted to Machir's family of Manasseh and then given to the sons of Gershom.

clauses.english: was allotted to the children of Machir of Manasseh
clauses.quote: were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh

clauses.english: was given with its suburbs to the sons of Gershom
clauses.quote: Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs

doubts: DEU 1:4, JOS 9:10, JOS 12:4 and JOS 13:12 only place King Og at Ashtaroth or speak of his kingdom, so they are not used.
1CH 11:44 names Uzzia the Ashterathite only in a list of warriors, so it is left out.
